systemProfile.confirmedDescription: Stores durable planning records for an agency deployment.

nistInformationTypes.name: Strategic Planning
specialFactorsConsidered: The deployment aggregates non-public draft plans and durable planning records.
nistInformationTypes.rationale: The NIST provisional profile is a starting point; deployment-specific aggregation and durable-record consequences raise all three applied objectives.

c.rationale: Aggregated planning records and workforce identifiers require moderate confidentiality.

i.rationale: Planning and prioritization decisions depend on record integrity.

a.rationale: Permanent loss of durable planning records would have a serious adverse effect.

nistInformationTypes.name: Strategic Planning
specialFactorsConsidered: The agency will store non-public planning material but can reconstruct its limited deployment records.
nistInformationTypes.rationale: Actual agency use raises confidentiality and integrity while its reconstructibility evidence leaves availability low.

c.rationale: The deployment will contain moderate-impact planning records.

i.rationale: The agency relies on accurate prioritization and status records.

a.rationale: The agency can reconstruct its limited deployment data from authoritative sources.

agencyUseSummary.rationale: ASO is the per-objective maximum for the definite deploying agency.

divergences.rationale: The operator confirmed that this deployment is reconstructible from authoritative records.
